news.h: Despite loss to Broncos, Fernando Mendoza settling in as Raiders' starting QB
news.d: Fernando Mendoza, making his second start for the Raiders, had good and bad moments Sunday at Denver. He completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards and three touchdowns but was sacked five times and pressured 16 times, and threw a game-sealing pick-six.
